belz cache <uuid>...  :->  Invalidate specific cache entries on the active environment (POSTs both invalidate routes, body {"uuids":[...]})
belz cache --type PAGE <uuid>  :->  Invalidate non-AUTOMATION cache entries by UUID
belz cache --all --yes [--type <TYPE>]  :->  Flush the ENTIRE cache of a type org-wide (refused without both flags)
belz cache prune-local  :->  Dry run: list stale local cache artifacts (pre-env-scoping flat files, abandoned refresh locks) that would be removed
belz cache prune-local --yes  :->  Delete stale local cache artifacts (local filesystem only, no network, no environment)
